name: Dalenys (Payplug) Payment Platform API
description: Dalenys (now Payplug) Payment Platform API providing authentication, payment facilitation, reporting, and self-onboarding capabilities for marketplace and payment facilitator integrations. Supports submerchant management, KYC processing, report generation, and bearer token authentication via OAuth2 client credentials flow.
